meta.what: THE GRAMMAR every entry is written in, preloaded or agent-made: the eight operators (Operators table, Figure 12), the two qualifiers, the NSM prime correspondence, the symbols of the loop (Symbols table) and the six substrate terms (Figure 13). Taken from the figure text; nothing here is the seat's invention.
meta.price: |phi| = (k+1)*log2(|atoms|+1) + (k-1)*log2(|bonds|)  -- Figure 12 / Operators table. Negation is unary and does not enter |bonds|.
meta.symmetry: Under a symmetric bond (+, ||, ==) k operands have k! spellings and one term; under an ordered bond different orders are different terms (Operators table).

+.name: conjunction
+.test: swap the operands. Does the meaning change? No.
+.note: the only bond in a flat formula

∥.name: disjunction
∥.test: remove one. Does it still work? Yes.
∥.nsm: (none -- MAYBE this / MAYBE that; open item)

≡.name: identity
≡.test: substitute one for the other. Is anything lost? No.
≡.note: decided at library level, never on a board record

→.name: sequence
→.means: A then B; B needs A to have happened
→.test: swap them. Does it become a different thing? Yes.
→.note: the only bond a flat chain can express
implemented_by: a chain (gamma.Term): applying atoms in sequence IS the sequence bond

⇒.name: production
⇒.means: A produces B; B did not exist before
⇒.test: is there a B before A fires? No.
⇒.note: the second operand is absent until the first fires
⇒.implemented_by_note: no executable form yet: production is TESTED over frames (composer.holds: is there a B before A fires?), not computed

−.name: subtraction
−.means: A with B removed or absent
−.test: is the second operand's absence the point? Yes.
−.implemented_by_note: no executable form yet: subtraction is TESTED over frames (composer.holds), not computed

⋛.name: comparison
⋛.means: a threshold relation between two quantities
⋛.test: is it about which is larger, rather than both being present? Yes.

¬.name: negation
¬.test: is the point that it is false, rather than absent? Yes.
¬.note: a refutation is a negation; unary, not a bond

unknown_bond.means: a junction written '+' in the source whose bond is not stated: UNKNOWN until the ground settles it (Isaiah 2026-09-22: '+' is a placeholder; Figure 12: 'which one holds is not recoverable from the operands')

qualifiers.A(x): A, qualified -- narrows one operand (high, low, depleting, zero, unbounded, increasing ...); NOT an operator
qualifiers.A?: A, optional -- present in some instances and not others

frames_nsm.note: NSM_GRAMMAR.md: substantives are the placeholder variables (existential SOMETHING, bound THIS, binding THE SAME, anti-binding OTHER); frames carry arity so a relation has somewhere to live; connectives are the operators.

primes_full.note: The standard NSM inventory (Goddard and Wierzbicka). NSM_GRAMMAR.md used about 24 of these; the time, space, quantity and mental-predicate primes were missing and are what the prepositions decompose into.

symbols.Γ: the library: primitives and everything buildable from them
symbols.atoms(Γ): the primitives: terms not built from anything else
symbols.closure(Γ): the reach: everything expressible by combining the primitives at any depth
symbols.b: the belief before acting (history and inheritance mixed by w)
symbols.w: the weighting between private history and inherited prior
symbols.R: the residual, per slot; the aim, not only the error signal
symbols.s: the slot: one object, region or entity tracked
symbols.R⁺_s: the live mass on slot s
symbols.|φ|: its cost under a declared code
symbols.|R|φ|: the leftover once φ explains what it can
symbols.bond: the typed relation between two operands
symbols.the ground: whatever settles the question; not in the library
symbols.the habitat: everything in contact with the residual; enumerated, never composed

energy.means: conserved, finite, and directionless on its own

spectrum.means: ordering, so that more and less can be said

gradient.means: a difference that can be spent; directed

network.means: that entities relate at all, and influence travels between them

substrate.rule: Figure 13: the set is closed, the arrangements are not; everything else is a composition across the two kinds, never within one

against.grid: o pushes on x, or moves opposite to x

till.grid: up to the moment x happens

prepositions_meta: Isaiah 2026-10-08: atoms act as subject or verb by sentence position; prepositions mark the role a second operand plays. Each preposition maps to an NSM prime (or prime combination), the operator it realises, and the readings it reads. They are ROLE MARKERS on a frame's slots, not new atoms: 'contagion OF x' fills the patient slot; 'move FROM a TO b' the source and goal slots.

roles.meta: ONE atom, several views, chosen by the slot it fills in a frame (effect vs affect: the noun and the verb are one concept). Generated, never authored per atom.

PROCESS.reads: the reading's change across frames (DELTA, prev)
PROCESS.templates: change templates (moves, up, down; prev != now)
PROCESS.example: contagion OF x (it spreads to x)

CAUSE.reads: what changes after the atom holds

INSTRUMENT.reads: the object that makes the change happen
INSTRUMENT.templates: the change happens only when this object takes part
INSTRUMENT.example: damping material (what damping is done WITH)

TEST.templates: the three-valued evaluation of the atom
